SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
V. D 3503.
Date 25 / 4 / 32.

April 25, 32.

Sir,
With reference to your letter No.196 of April
12, enquiries at the Dah An Bookstore (大亞書局),
150 Shantung Road shew that the order sent by Sergeant
Taung Sih Tsung (湯席珍) of the Public Safety Bureau,
Pao San Hsien (保山縣), Yunnan had been received,
but due to the carelessness of an employee of the store
the order had not been executed.
The manager has now despatched the books by
registered post for which he holds receipts Nos.
151897 and 151899.
The Dah An Bookstore (大亞書局) has been established
for eight years and appears to be a reliable concern.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).
for Commissioner of Police.

Colonel Wen Ying Sing,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Greater Shanghai Municipality.

先生：

REPORT ON attached letter

Made by D.I. Hall Forwarded by

Sir,
Re attached letter I beg to report that on the
18.4.32 I interviewed the manager of the Dah Au Bookshop
( ) of 150 Shantung Road, named Tsai Dien
Ming ( ) when he promised to make full enquiries
At 10 a.m. this inst he again came to the Station
and stated that on looking through his books, he found
that such an order had been received but had not been
carried out owing to the slackness of one of his
assistants. The books have now been sent off by
registered post, the receipts for which, Nos. 151897 and
151899, are now in his possession.

（签名）
D.I.

The Dah Au Bookshop has conducted
business at its present address for 8
years and seems to be a reliable
concern.
H. Robertson
C.D.I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S. B. REGISTRY. 3503. Date 11/4/38.）

Translation of letter from the Shanghai public safety bureau.
法 1.0.196                                                                 April 12, 193 .

Major F. W. Gerrard,
Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.
Sir,

I have to inform you that a complaint has been made by a Sergeant named Tang Si Tsung (湯席珍) attached to the Public Safety Bureau of Pao Shan Hsien (保山縣), Hunan, stating that in July 1931, a catalogue was sent to them by the Da Ya Book Store (大亞書局), Shanghai, and on September 5, a remittance of $10.00 was sent to the said book store for the purchase of twenty-seven kinds of books which reached there on 9/10/31 and a receipt for same bearing the chop of the firm was given. A few months have now elapsed, and neither the books nor any word was sent to the buyer. Apparently it is a case of obtaining money by means of false pretences. The book store is situated in the Chung Yuen Li (春源里) off Lyen How Di (九畝地), West Lyou Chong; Va (西舊倉街), Old North Gate. He craves that enquiries be made into the case in order to have his remittance refunded. Instructions were given to the No. 1 Sub-station of No. 2 District to institute enquiries, and it was ascertained that the said book store had removed from its former address to No. 156 Poo Ai Fang (普愛坊) off Shantung Road during the recent hostilities.

As this address is within the jurisdiction of the International Settlement, I hope that enquiries will be made into the case and action be taken, if necessary, either to recover the loss sustained by the complainant or forward the books in question. Kindly favour me with a reply in due course.

Wen Yin Sing,
Chief of Public Safety Bureau.

总监办公室。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与情报科登记处。 3503. 日期 38年4月11日。）

上海公安局来函译文。
法 1.0.196                                                                 193 .年4月12日。

F. W. Gerrard 少校，
警务总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
先生：

兹通知阁下，湖南省保山縣（原文如此，应为云南）公安局所属一名名为湯席珍的巡长提出投诉，称1931年7月，上海大亞書局（大亞書局）向其寄送了一份目录，随后于9月5日向该书店汇款10.00美元，用于购买二十七种书籍，该款项于31年10月9日到达，并收到了盖有该公司印章的收据。数月已过，买家既未收到书籍，也未收到任何音讯。这显然是一起以虚假借口骗取钱财的案件。该书店位于西舊倉街九畝地春源里。他恳请对此案进行调查，以便退还其汇款。已指示第二区第一分署进行调查，经查实，该书店在最近战事期间已从原址迁至山东路普愛坊156号。

由于该地址属于公共租界管辖范围，希望贵处能对此案进行调查，并在必要时采取行动，要么追回投诉人所受损失，要么寄送相关书籍。敬请适时赐复。

温应星，
公安局局长。
